sources.processing: api.census.gov returned the missing-key page, so it was not used. The documented keyless call https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5?get=NAME,B01003_001E,B11001_001E,B17001_001E,B17001_002E,B08201_001E,B08201_002E&for=tract:*&in=state:37&in=county:135 was not used for the numbers. sources.terms: Orange County food resource list published by N.C. Cooperative Extension. Confirm reuse terms on the publisher page before redistribution.
sources.processing: Pantries, meal sites, and food distributions from the published sheet. Hours are the Days open and Times open cells, stored verbatim and marked published-unverified. Blank hours stay blank. Coordinates come only from a Census geocode match. Rows without a match are omitted rather than given an invented point. Carrboro rows, including Inter-Faith Council, are kept even when the point is outside the coverage polygon. Operating capacity is unavailable. findHelp was not called. NC OneMap publishes no food-resource dataset.
